_readme: Gamepad scheme this targets: left stick = yaw/pitch, right stick X = roll,
right stick Y = throttle, LT/RT = fire, D-pad = power management.
The POV hat maps to the D-pad automatically (hat_to_dpad), which gives you
engines/weapons/shields/balance on the hat. That alone is worth the build.
THROTTLE CAVEAT: Squadrons moves throttle with right-stick-Y as a RATE, not
an absolute position. Your lever will feel like a speed-of-change control.
Test it: if it ramps instead of tracking the lever, set throttle_rate_mode
true below to have the sender emulate absolute positioning.
